body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Toshiba presented its laptop 'mini NB305' at CES 2010, designed with a full-size keyboard and touchpad and allowing to enjoy unplugged freedom of up to 11 hours on a single charge.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
